2) For Rui, can you confirm approximate scale (peak tokens/sec or per-minute throughput) and whether he managed autoscaling policies in a multi-tenant GPU environment?

Laura — quick answers inline.

> Can you confirm Ella's hands-on exposure to quantization-friendly kernels (4/8-bit) and whether she has shipped production model variants with quantized execution paths?

Yes — Ella led an initiative at VectorScale to validate 4-bit kernels for a flagship recommendation model. She worked with the infra team to gate rollouts, measure latency regressions and set caching strategies for warmed KV. She can speak to both the engineering trade-offs and the rollout safeguards.

> For Rui, can you confirm approximate scale (peak tokens/sec or per-minute throughput) and whether he managed autoscaling policies in a multi-tenant GPU environment?

Rui managed rollout on a 16-GPU cluster with sustained 120k tokens/minute peaks for a chat product. He also authored autoscaling policies based on prefix-hits and batch latency thresholds.

I've attached the two resumes again and a short plain-text note linking our shortlist: molehill_shortlist_link.txt (includes GH IDs and local notes).

We can tentatively block Tue 9/14 10:00 (Ella) and Wed 9/15 09:30 (Rui). I'll send calendar invites once you tell me who will lead the 60m design session (Aditya or Laura).

Attachments: 20260912_CV_EllaParkinson_resume.pdf, 20260912_CV-RuiZhang_resume.pdf, molehill_shortlist_link.txt

Thanks — Samira

On a related note, candidates prefer virtual panels; please confirm you're set to run Google Meet links (we'll include them in the invites).

Quick post-interview recap — thanks for coordinating everyone. Notes below for the hiring packet: 

Ella Parkinson (Interviewed Tue 9/14 10:00 PT) — 30m screen (Marissa) + 60m design (Laura):
  • Strengths: deep operational knowledge of quantized execution, practical rollout safeguards, good tradeoff framing on latency vs model accuracy.
  • Concerns: limited experience on multi-tenant billing/chargeback; will need pairing on cost-accounting practices.
  • Recommendation: advance to hiring manager loop; prepare offer with standard IC-3 comp band.

Rui Zhang (Interviewed Wed 9/15 09:30 PT) — 30m screen + 60m design (Aditya):
  • Strengths: solid autoscaling + batching heuristics, experience with large sustained throughput. Very familiar with GPU cluster tuning.
  • Concerns: less recent exposure to modern attention-optimized kernels (mostly worked on CPU fallbacks in last role).
  • Recommendation: advance to hiring manager loop with a technical homework focused on kernel/runtime tradeoffs.

Attachments: I uploaded the resumes to the GH candidate profiles and attached the shortlist link for the packet. Samira — can you confirm expected notice period for both candidates and preferred start windows? That will help comp/time-to-hire planning.

Also looping in Aditya and hiring team in a separate invite for manager loops next week.

Thanks,
